title: Highly recommend these products!
text: I can’t say enough good things about the STEM Club!  I started our subscription for my 5-year-old granddaughter almost one year ago and she absolutely loves getting these in the mail.  Not only is it fostering her innate curiosity in the science fields, it also has been helpful in providing quality time with her father or mother as most of the kits are a little bit of a stretch for her. If you are thinking of subscribing, don’t hesitate. The kits are well worth the money and with the ability to choose how often to deliver them, what’s not to like?
label: positive
